## What problem does this solve

What are you trying to do that the app doesn't currently support?

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen. If you have a specific UI or flow in mind,
describe it — a rough sketch or description is fine.

## Alternatives considered

Any other ways you thought about solving this, and why you'd prefer the
approach above.

## Additional context

Is this related to something already listed in
[ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) (including the "Ideas under consideration"
section)? Link it if so — helps avoid duplicate discussion.
